mcq.stem: Which secure protocol is the modern replacement for unencrypted HTTP on the web?
mcq.explanation: HTTPS encrypts web traffic using TLS.

mcq.stem: Which port does SSH commonly use by default?
mcq.explanation: SSH listens on TCP 22 by default; Telnet uses 23.

mcq.stem: LDAPS typically secures directory queries using TLS on which common port?
mcq.explanation: LDAPS commonly uses TCP 636 with TLS.

mcq.stem: EDR agents on endpoints primarily provide:

choices.text: Detection, investigation, and response on hosts

mcq.explanation: Endpoint detection and response tools monitor and help contain host threats.

mcq.stem: Normalized log timestamps across systems MOST require:

choices.text: Reliable time sync (e.g., NTP) and consistent time zones/UTC policy

mcq.explanation: Correlating events fails when clocks drift or time zones are inconsistent.

mcq.stem: Vulnerability scans that authenticate to targets generally produce:

choices.text: More accurate findings with fewer false negatives on missing patches

mcq.explanation: Credentialed scans can inspect installed software and configs more deeply.

mcq.stem: A CVSS score helps organizations:
mcq.explanation: CVSS provides a standardized severity rating to guide patch priority.

mcq.stem: During incident response, containment should occur:

choices.text: After detection/analysis enough to act, before full eradication completes
Never — only wait for attackers to leave

mcq.explanation: Containment limits damage while analysis continues and eradication is prepared.

mcq.stem: Preserving volatile memory captures is MOST important when investigating:
mcq.explanation: RAM captures can reveal malware that never touches disk.

mcq.stem: Which backup strategy keeps a recent copy offline and unreachable to ransomware?

choices.text: Only sync folders mapped as writable network drives
Emailing zips to self without retention

mcq.explanation: Offline/immutable copies survive encryptors that target connected shares.

mcq.stem: RTO measures:

choices.text: How quickly a service must be restored after disruption
How much data loss is acceptable in time

mcq.explanation: Recovery Time Objective is the target downtime limit; RPO covers data loss tolerance.

mcq.stem: RPO measures:

choices.text: Maximum tolerable data loss measured in time

mcq.explanation: Recovery Point Objective defines how much data you can afford to lose.

mcq.stem: Which TWO protocols should be preferred over their cleartext predecessors?

choices.text: SFTP or FTPS instead of FTP
SNMPv3 instead of SNMPv1/v2c community strings

mcq.explanation: Encrypted/authenticated variants replace insecure legacy management and file protocols.

mcq.stem: A SOAR platform primarily helps by:

choices.text: Automating playbooks that enrich alerts and execute response steps

mcq.explanation: Security orchestration automates repetitive IR workflows.

mcq.stem: NetFlow/IPFIX data is MOST useful for:

choices.text: Understanding traffic patterns and spotting anomalies

mcq.explanation: Flow records summarize conversations without full packet payloads.

mcq.stem: A penetration test differs from a vulnerability scan because it:

choices.text: Actively exploits findings to prove impact under rules of engagement
Only lists CVEs without context ever

mcq.explanation: Pen tests attempt exploitation; scans mainly identify potential issues.

mcq.stem: After eradication, which step validates systems are clean before full restore of trust?
mcq.explanation: Recovery returns services carefully while watching for reinfection.

mcq.stem: Tabletop exercises primarily improve:

choices.text: Decision-making and communication during simulated incidents

mcq.explanation: Tabletops walk teams through scenarios without live system changes.

mcq.stem: DNS over HTTPS (DoH) primarily improves:

choices.text: Confidentiality of DNS queries on the local network path

mcq.explanation: DoH encrypts DNS lookups so on-path observers cannot easily read them.

mcq.stem: Allowlisting (application control) is MOST effective against:

choices.text: Unknown/unauthorized executables including many ransomware strains
Authorized signed LOB apps only failing

mcq.explanation: Only approved binaries run, blocking many novel malware files.

mcq.stem: A honeypot’s MAIN purpose is to:

choices.text: Attract and study attackers while diverting them from real assets

mcq.explanation: Decoy systems reveal attacker TTPs with lower production risk.

mcq.stem: Which TWO actions support forensic readiness?
mcq.explanation: Reliable logs and chain-of-custody processes enable investigations.

mcq.stem: Bug bounty programs incentivize:

choices.text: External researchers to report vulnerabilities responsibly

mcq.explanation: Rewards channel disclosure to the vendor instead of silent exploitation.

mcq.stem: IPsec ESP primarily provides:

choices.text: Confidentiality (and optionally integrity) for IP packets

mcq.explanation: ESP encrypts packet payloads for VPN/secure IP communication.

mcq.stem: A hot site differs from a cold site mainly by:

choices.text: Being nearly ready to run with systems and data near-current
Having no power or connectivity ever
Being only a empty warehouse without plans

mcq.explanation: Hot sites minimize RTO with live or standby capacity; cold sites need build-out.

mcq.stem: Host-based firewalls complement network firewalls by:

choices.text: Enforcing per-endpoint rules even on internal or roaming hosts

mcq.explanation: Local firewalls protect devices beyond perimeter choke points.

mcq.stem: UEBA analytics look for:

choices.text: Behavioral anomalies relative to users’ and entities’ baselines

mcq.explanation: User and entity behavior analytics flag unusual access patterns.

mcq.stem: Lessons-learned meetings after an incident should FIRST focus on:

choices.text: Process and control improvements without blame-only narratives

mcq.explanation: Post-incident reviews drive measurable improvements for next time.
